remaining_defects.summary: Artifact SHA is path-sensitive in deploy.sh (absolute dashboard paths are part of the hash input).
remaining_defects.impact: Recomputing the green hash from the remote staging tree with absolute remote paths will not equal last-green; content hashes still match. Production gate compares operator-local artifact_sha() to last-green.
remaining_defects.recommendation: Normalize to content-only hashing (basename or sorted content digests) before the next promotion wave.

remaining_defects.summary: AI authoring foundation is staging-flag gated and does not publish to the live bank; there is no separate AI route that can mutate frozen scores/norms, but send_assessment remains an eligible human-confirm tool action.
remaining_defects.impact: AI still cannot change questions/keys/scores/norms/decisions; it can only propose authoring drafts under WATHEFNI_ASSESSMENT_AUTHORING.
remaining_defects.recommendation: Keep authoring flag off in production until a dedicated production authoring cutover is approved.
